decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated five different types of backpacks: a 40L hiking pack, a 45L tactical rucksack, a 52L ultralight pack, a hydration pack, and a sling bag. The Granite Gear 52L (prod_backpacks_041) was a contender for serious hiking but had several reports of strap failure. The military tactical pack (prod_backpacks_164) is well-rated but more specialized. I decided on the SHENHU 40L Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_111) because it offers a great balance of capacity, features like multiple pockets and water resistance, and consistently positive reviews at a very accessible price point of $26.99.
